LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 瑪莉，這家專櫃的洋裝看起來真漂亮，而且現在週年慶打八折呢！
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 玛莉，这家专柜的洋装看起来真漂亮，而且现在周年庆打八折呢！
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary, this boutique's dress looks really beautiful, and there's a twenty percent discount for the anniversary sale!

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 是挺好看的，但買衣服一定要先試穿，試穿看看合不合身再決定。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 是挺好看的，但买衣服一定要先试穿，试穿看看合不合身再决定。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: It's quite nice, but when buying clothes one must always try them on first to see if they fit well before deciding.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 妳說得對。那我先進去試穿這件淺藍色的。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 你说得对。那我先进去试穿这件浅蓝色的。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: You're right. Then I'll go inside first to try on this light blue one.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 瑪莉，妳看這件怎麼樣？我覺得腰部有點緊，而且價格還是太高了。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 玛莉，你看这件怎么样？我觉得腰部有点紧，而且价格还是太高了。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mary, what do you think of this piece? I feel the waist is a bit tight, and the price is still too high.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 與其買一件不舒服的名牌洋裝，不如到樓上的平價專櫃看看，那裡款式也很多。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 与其买一件不舒服的名牌洋装，不如到楼上的平价专柜看看，那里款式也很多。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Rather than buying an uncomfortable designer dress, it would be better to check the affordable section upstairs; there are many styles there too.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 可是樓上的衣服材質怎麼樣？我什麼衣服都穿過，就是皮膚容易過敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 可是楼上的衣服材质怎么样？我什么衣服都穿过，就是皮肤容易过敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: But how is the material of the clothes upstairs? I've worn all kinds of clothes, it's just that my skin is easily allergic, so I can't wear rough fabrics.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 瑪莉
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 放心吧，樓上有幾個專櫃不僅質料柔軟，價格也很實在。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 放心吧，楼上有几个专柜不仅质料柔软，价格也很实在。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Don't worry, several boutiques upstairs not only have soft materials, but their prices are very fair.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 太好了！那我們別再這裡浪費時間了，趕快上樓去逛逛吧。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 太好了！那我们别再这里浪费时间了，赶快上楼去逛逛吧。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Awesome! Then let's not waste more time here, let's head upstairs quickly to look around.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 在現代消費社會中，每個人都希望能「買得開心、用得放心」。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 在现代消费社会中，每个人都希望能「买得开心、用得放心」。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: In modern consumer society, everyone hopes to 'buy with joy and use with peace of mind.'

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 俗話說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是在購買貴重物品前，多比較幾家商店的價格與品質，才不會吃虧上當。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 俗话说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是在购买贵重物品前，多比较几家商店的价格与品质，才不会吃亏上当。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: As the proverb says, 'Shop around and you won't suffer a loss,' meaning before purchasing expensive items, compare prices and quality across several stores so you won't get cheated.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 以前人們為了比價，得跑好幾家實體店鋪，費時又費力。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 以前人们为了比价，得跑好几家实体店铺，费时又费力。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: In the past, to compare prices people had to run around several physical shops, which was time-consuming and laborious.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 現在網路科技發達，大家不僅能透過比價網站輕鬆查詢價格，還能參考其他消費者的評價。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 现在网路科技发达，大家不仅能透过比价网站轻松查询价格，还能参考其他消费者的评价。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: Now with advanced internet technology, people not only can easily query prices via price-comparison sites, but also consult reviews from other consumers.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 消費者變得一次比一次聰明，商家也一年比一年更注重產品質量與售後服務。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 消费者变得一次比一次聪明，商家也一年比一年更注重产品质量与售后服务。
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: Consumers become smarter each time, and businesses focus more on product quality and customer service year after year.

LESSON_THREE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · It Won't Hurt to Shop Around

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express trying an action before deciding to buy or use something with 試+V.
grammarPages.explanation: 決定購買或使用某物品以前，先試試看是不是真的喜歡、真的合適。這個「V」常是單音節的動詞，例如：吃、穿、用、喝、開等。

items.question: When do you use 試穿 instead of 穿穿看?
items.answer: 試穿 specifically emphasizes testing an item for fit and suitability before deciding to purchase.
items.wrongTraditional: 你可以穿穿看這件洋裝，看合不合適。
items.wrongSimplified: 你可以穿穿看这件洋装，看合不合适。
items.wrongPinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ chuānchuān kàn zhè jiàn yángzhuāng, kàn hé bu héshì.
items.wrongEnglish: You can try wearing this dress to see if it fits.
items.explanation: While 穿穿看 expresses an attempt, 試穿 specifically highlights testing suitability prior to a purchase decision.

right.traditional: 你可以試穿這件洋裝，看合不合適。
right.simplified: 你可以试穿这件洋装，看合不合适。
right.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ shìchuān zhè jiàn yángzhuāng, kàn hé bu héshì.
right.english: You can try on this dress to see if it fits.

items.question: Can 試 be reduplicated before another verb (e.g. 試試躺)?
items.answer: No, use single 試 followed by a monosyllabic verb (試躺, 試吃, 試喝).
items.wrongTraditional: 買床的時候一定要試試躺。
items.wrongSimplified: 买床的时候一定要试试躺。
items.wrongPinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhou yídìng yào shìshi tǎng.
items.wrongEnglish: When buying a bed you must try lying down.
items.explanation: Do not reduplicate 試 before another verb; use single 試 + monosyllabic verb (試躺).

right.traditional: 買床的時候一定要試躺。
right.simplified: 买床的时候一定要试躺。
right.pinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhou yídìng yào shìtǎng.
right.english: When buying a bed you must try lying down on it.

text.traditional: 這套淺色的也很好看，妳都試穿一下吧！
text.simplified: 这套浅色的也很好看，你都试穿一下吧！
text.pinyin: Zhè tào qiǎnsè de yě hěn hǎokàn, nǐ dōu shìchuān yíxià ba!
text.english: This light-colored outfit is also very pretty; why don't you try them both on!

text.traditional: 買床的時候一定要試躺，覺得舒服再買。
text.simplified: 买床的时候一定要试躺，觉得舒服再买。
text.pinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhou yídìng yào shìtǎng, juéde shūfu zài mǎi.
text.english: When buying a bed you must try lying down on it, and only buy if it feels comfortable.

text.traditional: 那家超商提供新口味的飲料給客人免費試喝，喝過的人都說好喝。
text.simplified: 那家超商提供新口味的饮料给客人免费试喝，喝过的人都说好喝。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshāng tígōng xīn kǒuwèi de yǐnliào gěi kèrén miǎnfèi shìhē, hē guò de rén dōu shuō hǎohē.
text.english: That convenience store provides free samples of the new flavor drink for customers to try, and everyone who tasted it said it was delicious.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Before deciding to buy a product or to use it, first try to see if you really like it or if it is really suitable. There "V" are often monosyllable verbs, such as 吃, 穿, 用, 喝, 開, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express disposal, consumption, disappearance, or undesirable removal with V掉.
grammarPages.explanation: 「掉」是補語，用在及物動詞的後面，有去除或出現不好的結果的意思，例如：吃掉、扔掉、賣掉、拿掉等。如果「掉」用在不及物動詞的後面，表示離開的意思，例如：走掉、飛掉、跑掉、壞掉等。

items.question: How does 掉 differ from 完 as a result complement?
items.answer: 完 indicates finishing a task; 掉 indicates disposal, consumption away, or undesirable consequence.
items.wrongTraditional: 沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔了它完。
items.wrongSimplified: 没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔了它完。
items.wrongPinyin: Méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēng le tā wán.
items.wrongEnglish: After wearing a few times it tore, in the end had to throw it away.
items.explanation: 完 indicates finishing a process; 掉 denotes disposal, disappearance, or removal.

right.traditional: 沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
right.simplified: 没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
right.pinyin: Méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
right.english: After wearing them a few times they tore, so in the end they had to throw them away.

items.question: Why is 跑掉 used instead of 跑完?
items.answer: After an intransitive verb of movement, 掉 expresses departing or escaping away.
items.wrongTraditional: 我擔心送他皮鞋，他會走完。
items.wrongSimplified: 我担心送他皮鞋，他会走完。
items.wrongPinyin: Wǒ dānxīn sòng tā píxié, tā huì zǒuwán.
items.wrongEnglish: I worry if I gift him leather shoes, he will walk away.
items.explanation: Use 跑掉 or 走掉 for running away or departing, not 完.

right.traditional: 我擔心送他皮鞋，他會跑掉。
right.simplified: 我担心送他皮鞋，他会跑掉。
right.pinyin: Wǒ dānxīn sòng tā píxié, tā huì pǎodiào.
right.english: I worry if I gift him leather shoes, he will run away.

text.traditional: ……沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
text.simplified: ……没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
text.pinyin: Méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
text.english: After wearing them just a few times they tore, and in the end they had to throw them away.

text.traditional:
A：你那輛車不常開又舊得很，不如賣掉吧！
B：它還能開，賣掉太可惜了。
text.simplified:
A：你那辆车不常开又旧得很，不如卖掉吧！
B：它还能开，卖掉太可惜了。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ nà liàng chē bù cháng kāi yòu jiù de hěn, bùrú màidiào ba! B: Tā hái néng kāi, màidiào tài kěxí le.
text.english: A: You don't drive that car often and it's quite old; you might as well sell it off! B: It can still be driven; selling it would be such a pity.

text.traditional:
A：我擔心送皮鞋給男朋友，他會跑掉。
B：那就送他皮帶好了，這樣他就跑不掉了。
text.simplified:
A：我担心送皮鞋给男朋友，他会跑掉。
B：那就送他皮带好了，这样他就跑不掉了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ dānxīn sòng píxié gěi nánpéngyou, tā huì pǎodiào. B: Nà jiù sòng tā pídài hǎo le, zhèyàng tā jiù pǎo bu diào le.
text.english: A: I worry that if I gift leather shoes to my boyfriend, he will run away. B: Then give him a belt; that way he won't be able to run away.

words.pinyin: nà jiù sòng tā pídài hǎo le

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The complement 掉 is used after the transitive verb, and it means to remove or produce bad results, such as 吃掉, 扔掉, 賣掉, 拿掉, etc. If the complement 掉 is used after the intransitive verb, it means to leave. For example, 走掉, 飛掉, 跑掉, 壞掉, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express complete inclusion with one specific exception using 什麼(N)都……，就是…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「什麼（……）都……」表示「全部、任何」，例如：「他什麼忙都幫」表示他任何忙都會幫，「我什麼東西都吃」表示任何東西我都吃。而「就是」的後面是唯一的選擇或不同的情況。例如：他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶。

columns.pinyin: lǎobǎn yào wǒ měi tiān jiābān

items.question: Why use 就是 instead of 只是 in 什麼都好……?
items.answer: In the structure 什麼(N)都...，就是..., 就是 specifically introduces the sole exception to universal inclusion.
items.wrongTraditional: 這個專櫃什麼都好，只是價格高了很多。
items.wrongSimplified: 这个专柜什么都好，只是价格高了很多。
items.wrongPinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, zhǐshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
items.wrongEnglish: Everything at this counter is good, just the price is high.
items.explanation: When setting off a single exception against 什麼……都, 就是 emphasizes the sole exception.

right.traditional: 這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
right.simplified: 这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
right.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
right.english: Everything at this counter is great, except the prices are much higher.

items.question: Why use 就是不能 instead of 只要不?
items.answer: To contrast total willingness with one single refusal, use 就是不能.
items.wrongTraditional: 我剛畢業，什麼工作都願意做，只要不加班。
items.wrongSimplified: 我刚毕业，什么工作都愿意做，只要不加班。
items.wrongPinyin: Wǒ gāng bìyè, shénme gōngzuò dōu yuànyì zuò, zhǐyào bù jiābān.
items.wrongEnglish: I just graduated, willing to do any job, as long as no overtime.
items.explanation: To single out an explicit non-negotiable exception to 什麼工作都, use 就是不能.

right.traditional: 我什麼工作都願意做，就是不能接受天天加班。
right.simplified: 我什么工作都愿意做，就是不能接受天天加班。
right.pinyin: Wǒ shénme gōngzuò dōu yuànyì zuò, jiùshì bù néng jiēshòu tiāntiān jiābān.
right.english: I am willing to do any job, except I cannot accept daily overtime.

text.traditional: 我覺得這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
text.simplified: 我觉得这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
text.english: I feel everything at this counter is great, except the prices are much higher.

text.traditional: 我剛大學畢業，什麼工作都願意做，就是不能接受老闆要我每天加班。
text.simplified: 我刚大学毕业，什么工作都愿意做，就是不能接受老板要我每天加班。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dàxué bìyè, shénme gōngzuò dōu yuànyì zuò, jiùshì bù néng jiēshòu lǎobǎn yào wǒ měi tiān jiābān.
text.english: I just graduated from university and am willing to do any job, except I cannot accept the boss asking me to work overtime every day.

text.traditional: 文小姐從設計學校畢業後，什麼服裝都設計過，就是沒設計過帽子。
text.simplified: 文小姐从设计学校毕业后，什么服装都设计过，就是没设计过帽子。
text.pinyin: Wén xiǎojiě cóng shèjì xuéxiào bìyè hòu, shénme fúzhuāng dōu shèjì guò, jiùshì méi shèjì guò màozi.
text.english: After graduating from design school, Ms. Wen has designed all kinds of apparel, except she has never designed hats.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 什麼(N)都……，就是…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 什麼（……）都…… means "all, anything", for example, 他什麼忙都幫 means "He will help with anything." And 我什麼東西都吃 means "I will eat anything." The statement after 就是 means the only option or different situation. For example, 他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Advise someone to stop doing an action with 別再……了, or state cessation with 不再……了.
grammarPages.explanation: 「別再……了」的意思是，說話的人建議或提醒對方不要再做某件事情了，例如：別再讓父母擔心了。如果說話的人要提醒自己或敘述別人不再做某件事情了，就使用「不再……了」，例如：我不再喝酒了。
grammarPages.pattern: 別再 + Action + 了 / 不再 + Action + 了

patternTable.title: Urging Cessation or Stating No Longer

items.question: When do you use 別再……了 vs 不再……了?
items.answer: 別再……了 is an imperative urging someone else to stop; 不再……了 states personal cessation or a factual report.
items.wrongTraditional: 媽媽，妳不再幫我洗衣服了！我自己會洗。
items.wrongSimplified: 妈妈，你不再帮我洗衣服了！我自己会洗。
items.wrongPinyin: Māma, nǐ búzài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ zìjǐ huì xǐ.
items.wrongEnglish: Mom, you no longer wash clothes for me! I will do it myself.
items.explanation: When urging someone else to stop an action, use 別再……了 instead of 不再.

right.traditional: 媽媽，妳別再幫我洗衣服了！我自己會洗。
right.simplified: 妈妈，你别再帮我洗衣服了！我自己会洗。
right.pinyin: Māma, nǐ bié zài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ zìjǐ huì xǐ.
right.english: Mom, don't wash clothes for me anymore! I can wash them myself.

items.question: How do you state your own resolution to stop an activity?
items.answer: Use 不再……了 for your own cessation, not the imperative 別再.
items.wrongTraditional: 如果這次比賽輸了，我就別再踢足球了。
items.wrongSimplified: 如果这次比赛输了，我就别再踢足球了。
items.wrongPinyin: Rúguǒ zhè cì bǐsài shū le, wǒ jiù bié zài tī zúqiú le.
items.wrongEnglish: If we lose this match, I shouldn't play soccer anymore.
items.explanation: When declaring your own determination to quit, use 不再……了, not the imperative 別再.

right.traditional: 如果這次比賽輸了，我就不再踢足球了。
right.simplified: 如果这次比赛输了，我就不再踢足球了。
right.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhè cì bǐsài shū le, wǒ jiù búzài tī zúqiú le.
right.english: If we lose this match, I will no longer play soccer.

text.traditional: ……別再買了，妳還要去看球鞋呢！
text.simplified: ……别再买了，你还要去看球鞋呢！
text.pinyin: … Bié zài mǎi le, nǐ hái yào qù kàn qiúxié ne!
text.english: … Don't buy any more; you still have to go look at sneakers!

text.traditional:
孩子：你別再幫我洗衣服了！我自己會洗。
媽媽：我怕你洗不乾淨，如果洗得乾淨，我就不再幫你洗了。
text.simplified:
孩子：你别再帮我洗衣服了！我自己会洗。
妈妈：我怕你洗不干净，如果洗得干净，我就不再帮你洗了。
text.pinyin: Háizi: Nǐ bié zài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ zìjǐ huì xǐ. Māma: Wǒ pà nǐ xǐ bu gānjìng, rúguǒ xǐ de gānjìng, wǒ jiù bú zài bāng nǐ xǐ le.
text.english: Child: Don't wash clothes for me anymore! I can wash them myself. Mother: I worry you won't wash them clean; if you do, I won't wash them for you anymore.

words.pinyin: wǒ pà nǐ xǐ bu gānjìng
words.meaning: I fear you cannot wash them clean

text.traditional:
太太：你的腳受傷了，別再踢足球了。
先生：要是這次比賽輸了，我就不再踢了。
text.simplified:
太太：你的脚受伤了，别再踢足球了。
先生：要是这次比赛输了，我就不再踢了。
text.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ de jiǎo shòushāng le, bié zài tī zúqiú le. Xiānsheng: Yàoshi zhè cì bǐsài shū le, wǒ jiù bú zài tī le.
text.english: Wife: Your foot is injured; don't play soccer anymore. Husband: If we lose this match, I won't play anymore.

words.pinyin: yàoshi zhè cì bǐsài shū le

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 別再……了 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 別再……了 means that the person speaking suggests or reminds the other person not to do something anymore. For example, 別再讓父母擔心了。If the speaker reminds himself or mentions that others are not doing something anymore, use 不再……了. For example, 我不再喝酒了。

dialogue.title: 對話 · 貨比三家不吃虧 · It Won’t Hurt to Shop Around

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 瑪莉，這家專櫃的洋裝看起來真漂亮，而且現在週年慶打八折呢！
lines.simplified: 玛莉，这家专柜的洋装看起来真漂亮，而且现在周年庆打八折呢！
lines.english: Mary, this boutique's dress looks really beautiful, and there's a twenty percent discount for the anniversary sale!

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 是挺好看的，但買衣服一定要先試穿，試穿看看合不合身再決定。
lines.simplified: 是挺好看的，但买衣服一定要先试穿，试穿看看合不合身再决定。
lines.english: It's quite nice, but when buying clothes one must always try them on first to see if they fit well before deciding.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 妳說得對。那我先進去試穿這件淺藍色的。
lines.simplified: 你说得对。那我先进去试穿这件浅蓝色的。
lines.english: You're right. Then I'll go inside first to try on this light blue one.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 瑪莉，妳看這件怎麼樣？我覺得腰部有點緊，而且價格還是太高了。
lines.simplified: 玛莉，你看这件怎么样？我觉得腰部有点紧，而且价格还是太高了。
lines.english: Mary, what do you think of this piece? I feel the waist is a bit tight, and the price is still too high.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 與其買一件不舒服的名牌洋裝，不如到樓上的平價專櫃看看，那裡款式也很多。
lines.simplified: 与其买一件不舒服的名牌洋装，不如到楼上的平价专柜看看，那里款式也很多。
lines.english: Rather than buying an uncomfortable designer dress, it would be better to check the affordable section upstairs; there are many styles there too.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 可是樓上的衣服材質怎麼樣？我什麼衣服都穿過，就是皮膚容易過敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
lines.simplified: 可是楼上的衣服材质怎么样？我什么衣服都穿过，就是皮肤容易过敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
lines.english: But how is the material of the clothes upstairs? I've worn all kinds of clothes, it's just that my skin is easily allergic, so I can't wear rough fabrics.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 放心吧，樓上有幾個專櫃不僅質料柔軟，價格也很實在。
lines.simplified: 放心吧，楼上有几个专柜不仅质料柔软，价格也很实在。
lines.english: Don't worry, several boutiques upstairs not only have soft materials, but their prices are very fair.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 太好了！那我們別再這裡浪費時間了，趕快上樓去逛逛吧。
lines.simplified: 太好了！那我们别再这里浪费时间了，赶快上楼去逛逛吧。
lines.english: Awesome! Then let's not waste more time here, let's head upstairs quickly to look around.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect progressive reasons or features formally using 不僅……也/還/而且…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「不僅」當連接詞，有「不但」的意思，多用在書面，後面的分句句首用「還、也、而且」。

patternTable.title: Conjunction 不僅 (Not Only ..., But Also)

items.question: How does 不僅 differ from 只?
items.answer: 不僅 means "not only" and pairs with 也/還 for progressive addition, whereas 只 restricts to only one thing.
items.wrongTraditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，只比一比價格，也比品質。
items.wrongSimplified: 购物时要多看几家店，只比一比价格，也比品质。
items.wrongPinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, zhǐ bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, yě bǐ pǐnzhì.
items.wrongEnglish: When shopping check several shops, only compare price, also compare quality.
items.explanation: Use 不僅……還要/也要 to introduce two complementary considerations, not 只.

right.traditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比價格，還要比品質。
right.simplified: 购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比价格，还要比品质。
right.pinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bùjǐn yào bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ pǐnzhì.
right.english: When shopping check several stores: not only compare price, but also compare quality.

items.question: Can 不僅 be paired with 但是?
items.answer: No, 不僅 adds positive reinforcement and pairs with 也, 還, or 而且, not the contrastive 但是.
items.wrongTraditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作但是很認真。
items.wrongSimplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作但是很认真。
items.wrongPinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò dànshì hěn rènzhēn.
items.wrongEnglish: Mr. Xie not only is cheerful, but work is serious.
items.explanation: 不僅 pairs with 也, 還, or 而且 for progressive addition, never with contrastive 但是.

right.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真。
right.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真。
right.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn.
right.english: Mr. Xie not only has a cheerful personality, but is also very conscientious in his work.

text.traditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比一比價格，還要比一比品質。
text.simplified: 购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比一比价格，还要比一比品质。
text.pinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bùjǐn yào bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ yì bǐ pǐnzhì.
text.english: When shopping you should check several shops, not only comparing prices but also comparing quality.

words.pinyin: yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn

text.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真、負責，所以同事都很喜歡他。
text.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真、负责，所以同事都很喜欢他。
text.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn, fùzé, suǒyǐ tóngshì dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
text.english: Mr. Xie not only has a cheerful personality, but is also very serious and responsible at work, so his colleagues all like him very much.

text.traditional: 照華人的傳統，除夕當天不僅要打掃、貼春聯，而且家人要在一起吃年夜飯。
text.simplified: 照华人的传统，除夕当天不仅要打扫、贴春联，而且家人要在一起吃年夜饭。
text.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng, chúxì dāngtiān bùjǐn yào dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, érqiě jiārén yào zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
text.english: According to Chinese tradition, on New Year's Eve one not only sweeps and puts up spring couplets, but family must also gather to eat New Year's Eve dinner.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 不僅……也/還…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不僅 is used as a conjunction connective, which means the same as 不但. It is mostly used in writing. The beginning of the following clauses starts with 還, 也, 而且.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express gradual incremental changes across sequential units with 一M比一M + Vs.
grammarPages.explanation: 說明事物或情況的程度逐漸變化。例如：天氣一天比一天熱了。
grammarPages.pattern: NP + 一 M 比 一 M + Vs (了)

items.question: How does 一M比一M differ from 一M一M?
items.answer: 一M比一M expresses an incremental increase in degree across sequential items; 一M一M expresses sequential order without comparison.
items.wrongTraditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣一樣便宜。
items.wrongSimplified: 那里的商品常常是一样一样便宜。
items.wrongPinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng yí yàng piányi.
items.wrongEnglish: The goods there are often one by one cheap.
items.explanation: To express that each item is cheaper than the preceding one, use 一樣比一樣, not 一樣一樣.

right.traditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。
right.simplified: 那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。
right.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányi.
right.english: The merchandise there is often cheaper from one item to the next.

items.question: Where does 比 go in the 一M比一M structure?
items.answer: 比 must be placed between the two measure words: 一M + 比 + 一M + Vs.
items.wrongPinyin: Kōngqì yì nián yì nián bǐ chà le.
items.wrongEnglish: The air year after year compared worse.
items.explanation: The structure is 一M + 比 + 一M + Vs (一年比一年差), placing 比 between the measure words.

right.pinyin: Kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
right.english: The air has been getting worse year by year.

text.traditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。
text.simplified: 那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。
text.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányi.
text.english: The goods there are often cheaper from one item to the next.

text.traditional: 這個學期王小明很用功，考試的成績也一次比一次進步了。
text.simplified: 这个学期王小明很用功，考试的成绩也一次比一次进步了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqī Wáng Xiǎomíng hěn yònggōng, kǎoshì de chéngjì yě yí cì bǐ yí cì jìnbù le.
text.english: Wang Xiaoming is very hardworking this semester, and his exam scores improved with each test.

text.traditional: 這個地區因為工廠越來越多的關係，空氣一年比一年差了。
text.simplified: 这个地区因为工厂越来越多的关系，空气一年比一年差了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō de guānxi, kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
text.english: Because of more and more factories in this region, the air quality has worsened year by year.

words.pinyin: yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using NP 一M比一M + Vs (了) in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This sentence structure explains that the degree of a thing or situation changes gradually. For example, 天氣一天比一天熱了。

dialogue.title: 短文 · 比價 · Comparing Prices

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在現代消費社會中，每個人都希望能「買得開心、用得放心」。
lines.simplified: 在现代消费社会中，每个人都希望能「买得开心、用得放心」。
lines.english: In modern consumer society, everyone hopes to 'buy with joy and use with peace of mind.'

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 俗話說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是在購買貴重物品前，多比較幾家商店的價格與品質，才不會吃虧上當。
lines.simplified: 俗话说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是在购买贵重物品前，多比较几家商店的价格与品质，才不会吃亏上当。
lines.english: As the proverb says, 'Shop around and you won't suffer a loss,' meaning before purchasing expensive items, compare prices and quality across several stores so you won't get cheated.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 以前人們為了比價，得跑好幾家實體店鋪，費時又費力。
lines.simplified: 以前人们为了比价，得跑好几家实体店铺，费时又费力。
lines.english: In the past, to compare prices people had to run around several physical shops, which was time-consuming and laborious.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 現在網路科技發達，大家不僅能透過比價網站輕鬆查詢價格，還能參考其他消費者的評價。
lines.simplified: 现在网路科技发达，大家不仅能透过比价网站轻松查询价格，还能参考其他消费者的评价。
lines.english: Now with advanced internet technology, people not only can easily query prices via price-comparison sites, but also consult reviews from other consumers.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 消費者變得一次比一次聰明，商家也一年比一年更注重產品質量與售後服務。
lines.simplified: 消费者变得一次比一次聪明，商家也一年比一年更注重产品质量与售后服务。
lines.english: Consumers become smarter each time, and businesses focus more on product quality and customer service year after year.
